title: Fix Jira 404 console error fired on every findings drawer open when Jira not configured
goal: In the findings drawer JS, change the Jira integration status fetch from api() to apiOrNull() so a 404 does not produce a browser console error. Alternatively, check cached state.settings.integrations.jira_base_url before calling - if null or empty, skip the Jira fetch entirely and show a static 'Configure Jira in Settings' hint without an API roundtrip.
scope: Walkthrough 2026-04-30: Every finding drawer open logs 'Failed to load resource: 404 http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/engagements/{id}/integrations/jira'. Jira is not configured. The API correctly returns 404 but the UI issues the request unconditionally on every drawer open, polluting the console.
